response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal), AVG(feerate - rebrate) FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005;

assumptions.assumption: "high-rebate" records with 0.0005 as the cutoff means rebrate >= 0.0005 (inclusive). The phrase "cutoff" in common usage typically denotes an inclusive threshold (e.g., "passing grade is 60%" means >= 60%), but could be read as strictly greater.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is exclusive (rebrate strictly exceeds 0.0005, not equal to it)
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal), AVG(feerate - rebrate) FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005;
